name: Receive Inbox RabbitMQ Event
description: Consumes RabbitMQ event envelopes and stores accepted messages in the durable Inbox.

files.description: Consumes envelopes from an existing queue and maps receive results to RabbitMQ acknowledgements.
Validates incoming envelopes and stores them as received messages.
Configures the required consumer and Inbox processing schedule.
Defines the envelope accepted at transport and persistence boundaries.
Defines the Inbox persistence contract and duplicate-aware save result.
